note: Persona replicates from our own generator: fresh draws of the same four persona types. They catch overfitting to one noise realisation; they cannot show that a model avoided learning the generator.

tte.definition: Discrete-time survival, 30 s steps to 5 minutes, logistic hazard on v1's features plus a step one-hot; expected minutes = restricted mean survival time to 5 minutes (features held at the origin). S(60 s) is scored on v1's own label.

on_A0.guarantee: With probability at least 1 - delta over the calibration sample, the chosen rule's false-alarm rate on a new episode from the pooled training population is at most the budget, assuming exchangeable episodes and false alarms that arrive independently given the exposure.
breaks: a held-out person who differs from the training people (speed, skill, task mix)
a person who drifts (improves) over the weeks
positively correlated episodes within a person (the bound treats episodes as independent)
false alarms that cluster (over-dispersion relative to Poisson)

shuffle_person.role: diagnostic (keeps each person's own stuck rate)

primary_label.note: Extra columns from a synthetic generator show that the pipeline uses the planted signal, not that real signals predict stuck.
primary_label.label: no progress in the next 60 s (the label the hazard model is trained on; the planned ablation)

planted_label_supplementary.note: Extra columns from a synthetic generator show that the pipeline uses the planted signal, not that real signals predict stuck.
planted_label_supplementary.label: a planted stuck spell overlaps the next 60 s (supplementary: the label the awareness events were planted against)

ablation.note: The link between planted stuck spells and cursor behaviour is assumed by the awareness generator; a lift here shows the pipeline can use a planted signal, not that real cursors predict being stuck.
